Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?
How to acces the billing section

To access the billing section, follow these steps: 
1. Select the file type of the patient (OP, IP, new, or outsider). 
2. For a new patient, click on ‘F4’ to load the registration screen. 
3. For an existing patient, search by document ID, mobile number, or name. 
4. Click on the ‘Elig. Discovery’ button to verify insurance eligibility. 
5. Choose consultation or service for billing from the service list. 
6. For consultation billing, select a doctor to automatically populate available slot times. 
7. For laboratory or radiology items, select the item code or name and click ‘Add’. 
8. Select the payment category and allocate the cash/credit scheme to the patient. 
9. Click ‘Save’ to generate the service bill. 
10. You can also view patient documents, visit history, and apply discounts as needed. 

![Billing Section](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113256.png)
